Questions

Can we keep our existing name or logo?

Yes. An existing name or identity can stay when it still fits. We can refine it, or build the colors, type and guide around it.

Do you name businesses and properties?

Yes, when the project needs it. Naming is scoped in the proposal: a shortlist first, then the selected name carried into the identity.

What files do we receive?

Logo variations, color and type specifications, and a concise brand guide, plus the artwork for the applications we agree on.

Can you design the website too?

Yes. Most branding projects include the website, so the identity and the site launch together. See website design.

Who makes the signs?

We prepare the sign artwork. Fabrication, permitting and installation stay with your sign contractor, working from their dimensions, materials and lighting.

How long does branding take?

It depends on naming, the number of review rounds, and the applications. The proposal confirms the schedule before work starts.
